about: Jonathan E. Hawkins is a business lawyer for lawyer, author, and podcast host. He is the founder of Law Firm GC, which is based in Atlanta, Georgia. His practice focuses primarily on representing lawyers and law firms in their business-related legal needs. More specifically, he helps attorneys and law firm owners identify, understand, and navigate the legal, business, and ethics-related issues that stem from running a law practice. He routinely helps lawyers in lateral moves, law firm mergers and acquisitions, drafting partnership agreements , law firm dissolutions, separation agreements, and litigating law firm breakups . He also serves as Outside General Counsel to law firms throughout the nation.

He is the author of The Law Firm Life Cycle , a book that guides law firm owners through patterns, pitfalls, and proven strategies for every stage of a law firm’s growth. He also hosts Founding Partner Podcast , where he interviews founding attorneys and provides guidance on various issues relevant to law firm owners.

Over the years, he has worked with law firms of all types. Contingency and hourly. Plaintiff and defense. Personal injury, criminal, family, immigration, you name it. Startups and established firms. True solos and firms with 100+ attorneys and 100s of employees. Small firms and firms with multiple offices in multiple states.

In 1999, Mr. Hawkins graduated from the Georgia Institute of Technology with high honors. He then went on to obtain his law degree from the University of Georgia School of Law, where he served as managing editor for the Georgia Law Review and graduated cum laude.

Building experience in the public sector, Mr. Hawkins clerked for the Honorable John F. Nangle of the United States District Court in the Southern District of Georgia before he started his practice, and he went on to serve as Legal Counsel to the Judiciary Committee of the Georgia House of Representatives in 2010. He was awarded the Martindale-Hubbell's AV-Preeminent* rating and is noted by his peers as an outstanding lawyer.

*AV-Preeminent and BV-Distinguished are certification marks of Reed Elsevier Properties Inc., used in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell is the facilitator of a peer review rating process. Ratings reflect the confidential opinions of members of the Bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell ratings fall into two categories – legal ability and general ethical standards.
